About Us

Othaya Boys High School is a public, boys-only boarding school (C1 Senior School) near Othaya Town in Nyeri South Sub-County, Nyeri County. We nurture character, academic excellence and talent so every student can grow into a responsible leader.

Academics

Our Senior School offers three CBC pathways, helping each student build on their strengths.

STEM

Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics for future innovators.

Social Sciences

Languages, humanities and society subjects for well-rounded thinkers.

Arts & Sports

Creative arts, music, drama and sports for talented students.

School Life

Learning goes beyond the classroom through sports, clubs and service.

Sports

Football, rugby, athletics and more, building teamwork and fitness.

Clubs

Drama, music, debate, science and other student societies.

Leadership

Prefects and student councils that teach responsibility.

Contact

Visit us or reach out for admissions and general enquiries.
